gate: G8/F2-F4 target-specific thermal-solar anti-nu_e RIOEC provenance feasibility

source_authorities.title: The Very Low Energy Solar Flux of Electron and Heavy-Flavor Neutrinos and Antineutrinos
source_authorities.channel_identity: thermal solar neutrinos and antineutrinos of all flavors from pair processes
source_authorities.earth_flux_statement: per-flavor spectral flux density is calculated; abstract reports 1e8-1e9 cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1 below about 5 keV
production_processes: neutral-current decay of thermally populated nuclear states
source_authorities.limitation_for_next_numeric_fold: exact machine-readable anti-nu_e spectral table is not yet locally frozen in NMIR; a later numerical fold must materialize/digitize/recompute it prospectively rather than use chat-carried plot values

source_authorities.title: Towards the Detection of Thermal Solar Neutrinos
source_authorities.channel_identity: keV thermal solar neutrinos from electroweak processes in solar plasma
source_authorities.role: modern Standard-Model thermal-flux authority and detector-use cross-check
source_authorities.limitation: the accessible metadata establishes the physical SM thermal component but is not by itself a locally frozen electron-antineutrino differential spectrum

rioec_formalism_authorities.title: Resonant antineutrino induced electron capture with low energy bound-beta beams
rioec_formalism_authorities.key_formula_structure: sigma_RIOEC proportional to Breit-Wigner factor times Gamma_beta_b/Gamma; Gamma_beta_b is the reverse bound-beta partial width
rioec_formalism_authorities.scientific_implication: target linewidth alone cannot fix integrated entrance strength; an independently grounded reverse weak width/matrix element is mandatory

rioec_formalism_authorities.title: Resonant Induced Orbital Electron Capture: Novel method for low-energy anti-nu_e detection
rioec_formalism_authorities.candidate_scope: 15 candidate nuclides below 2 MeV; prominent public summaries name 63Cu, 129Xe, 159Tb
rioec_formalism_authorities.thermal_solar_claim: paper explicitly discusses keV-scale thermal solar antineutrinos
rioec_formalism_authorities.reason: NMIR requires an independently evaluated target-specific entrance-strength package before W/kg ranking; candidate identification is not sufficient F4 evidence

target_strength_audit.evidence: 2026 LiquidO geoneutrino primary study gives allowed 63Cu->63Ni/63Ni* charged-current transitions but states cross-section knowledge is highly sensitive to Log(ft) and calls for refined nuclear input or reactor calibration; a 10% Log(ft) change changes the cross section by about a factor 3
target_strength_audit.reason: the relevant weak strength is not demonstrated at the precision/transition mapping needed for a target-specific resonant fold; moreover the ordinary IBD transition is not automatically the exact excited-state RIOEC reverse width

target_strength_audit.evidence: NNDC/ENSDF publicly contains 159Gd beta-minus and 159Dy EC decay datasets feeding 159Tb, demonstrating that evaluated weak-decay data exist around the isobaric system
target_strength_audit.reason: the audit did not identify an independently evaluated reverse weak width for the exact daughter excited state plus atomic shell that produces a thermal-eV/keV RIOEC resonance; ground-state/isobar decay data cannot be substituted

target_strength_audit.evidence: 129I beta-minus decay to 129Xe is well established, but no audited source in this gate supplies a complete exact-state RIOEC entrance-strength/width package for a thermal-eV/keV resonance
target_strength_audit.reason: known neighboring beta decay does not by itself fix the reverse width of whichever excited daughter/shell is required by E_R=-Q_epsilon+E_x+E_b

source_side_conclusion: A physical Standard-Model thermal-solar antineutrino source class is independently established in primary literature. Exact differential spectrum materialization is still required before a numeric fold, but the source class itself is not the principal scientific blocker.
target_side_conclusion: No audited candidate in this iteration has a complete independently evaluated exact-state reverse weak entrance-strength/width package tied to the thermal-eV/keV RIOEC resonance. Therefore F4 fails closed and no events/kg/s or W/kg fold is allowed.
next_action: Do not scan more isotopes blindly. Either obtain a target paper/evaluated-data package that explicitly fixes the exact-state reverse bound-beta/EC weak width for a thermal-window RIOEC resonance, or move to the next independent OPEN class-level gate. If such a package appears, first locally freeze the differential anti-nu_e spectrum and target data under a new preregistration.
